sanskrit_verse:
सकामास्वनुलोमासु न दोषस्त्वन्यथा दमः ।
दूषणे तु करच्छेद उत्तमायां वधस्तथा ॥२.२८८
transliteration: sakāmāsv anulomāsu na doṣas tv anyathā damaḥ | dūṣaṇe tu karaccheda uttamāyāṃ vadhas tathā || 2.288
sph_interpretive_translation: In unions born of desire and conformity, no fault arises; otherwise, restraint is prescribed. In defamation, severance of hand is enacted; in violation of the highest woman, capital consequence is likewise executed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with conscious intention, not mere formality
Causation originates in misalignment with Dharma-consciousness, not social disapproval
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of consequence, not status
Restoration logic operates through proportional completion, not punitive retaliation
Consciousness alignment restores order through direct karmic rectification
executable_legal_axioms: IF union aligns with mutual dharmic intent THEN no legal consequence arises
IF action disrupts societal integrity AND violates sacred hierarchy THEN enforce physical cessation protocol
IF defamation occurs THEN execute immediate sensory withdrawal via limb disjunction
IF violation targets highest strata of spiritual-social order THEN invoke irreversible termination sequence
ALL enforcement actions MUST bypass subjective moral judgment and follow causal mapping exclusively
supreme_court_application: This verse establishes that only acts violating hierarchical consciousness warrant irreversible judicial response. Defamation breaches communicative sanctity requiring sensory rebalancing. Violation of elevated beings triggers ultimate corrective due to distortion of cosmic hierarchy. Courts must assess not act alone but its alignment with or disruption of Dharma-consciousness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that harm manifests sequentially based on deviation from svadharma. The severance or cessation is not punitive but a natural correction—anupūrvaśaḥ—of distorted consciousness back into alignment. Proportionality reflects karmic architecture, not retributive equivalence. Thus, justice serves restoration, not vengeance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate prāṇic realignment process for perpetrator upon minor transgressions
Enforce sensory recalibration through targeted bodily detachment in defamation cases
Activate irreversible dissolution protocols when higher-order consciousness is violated
Reintegrate societal memory post-enforcement to prevent recurrence without trauma perpetuation
Assign completion duties to affected parties to restore energetic balance within community
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law executes pure consciousness, restores integrity, and abolishes punitive delusion. Justice flows from awareness, not injury. Reality is non-punitive; consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
